settings.heading: Come and find us
settings.lede: The studio is in Garden City, five minutes from the Corniche. Knock, or write first — both work.

settings.heading: Write to the studio
settings.body: Questions about a set, a piece you want painted, or where your order is. Someone here reads all of it.
settings.form_note: We reply from Sunday to Thursday.
settings.address:
Per Set Atelier

settings.heading: The quick answers
settings.body: Most notes we get are one of these four.

settings.question: How long does an order take?
settings.answer: Sets in stock leave the studio in two to three working days. If a piece has to be painted for you, allow two to three weeks. We write to you when it goes into the kiln.

settings.question: Do you ship outside Egypt?
settings.answer: Yes. Rates are calculated at checkout from the studio address. Everything travels double-boxed with foam between each piece.

settings.question: Can I use these every day?
settings.answer: Please do. The glaze is fired hard and the paint sits under it. Dishwasher on a normal cycle is fine. Keep them out of the microwave — the gold does not like it.

settings.question: My plates are not identical. Is that right?
settings.answer: That is right. Every piece is painted by hand, so no two are identical. That is the point.
